svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: E-plane and H-plane cuts of a vertical half-wave dipole
svg.desc: Left: a vertical dipole with its doughnut-shaped radiation pattern, cut by a vertical plane that contains the wire (the E-plane) and a horizontal plane at right angles to it (the H-plane). Right: the two cuts drawn as polar plots, a figure of eight with nulls along the wire for the E-plane and a circle for the H-plane.
